Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Gorakhpur Project Technical Support-I Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Gorakhpur Project Technical Support-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 01-10-2026. Candidates should report at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Technical Support-I post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Project Technical Support-I position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Three-year Graduate degree in Life Science /Zoology/Botany/ Social Sciences/ Nursing with one year of experience in working in research projects.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Project Technical Support-I post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 25 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per ICMR guidelines.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Technical Support-I position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 21600 Per Month, including HRA.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST).

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held at All India Institute of Medical Sciences Gorakhpur (AIIMS Gorakhpur).

faq.question: Q10. Is prior online application required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, this recruitment is being conducted through a Walk-in Interview, and no prior online application is required.
